jobs.name: Sale
jobs.summary: Looks up five dimension keys for each staged sale line, then replaces those invoices in Fact.Sale and closes the load in the lineage log.
jobs.legacy_sql:
CREATE PROCEDURE Integration.MigrateStagedSaleData
WITH EXECUTE AS OWNER
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    SET XACT_ABORT ON;

    BEGIN TRAN;

    DECLARE @LineageKey int = (SELECT TOP(1) [Lineage Key]
                               FROM Integration.Lineage
                               WHERE [Table Name] = N'Sale'
                               AND [Data Load Completed] IS NULL
                               ORDER BY [Lineage Key] DESC);

    -- Find the dimension keys required

    UPDATE s
        SET s.[City Key] = COALESCE((SELECT TOP(1) c.[City Key]
                                     FROM Dimension.City AS c
                                     WHERE c.[WWI City ID] = s.[WWI City ID]
                                     AND s.[Last Modified When] > c.[Valid From]
                                     AND s.[Last Modified When] <= c.[Valid To]
									 ORDER BY c.[Valid From]), 0),
            s.[Customer Key] = COALESCE((SELECT TOP(1) c.[Customer Key]
                                           FROM Dimension.Customer AS c
                                           WHERE c.[WWI Customer ID] = s.[WWI Customer ID]
                                           AND s.[Last Modified When] > c.[Valid From]
                                           AND s.[Last Modified When] <= c.[Valid To]
									       ORDER BY c.[Valid From]), 0),
            s.[Bill To Customer Key] = COALESCE((SELECT TOP(1) c.[Customer Key]
                                                 FROM Dimension.Customer AS c
                                                 WHERE c.[WWI Customer ID] = s.[WWI Bill To Customer ID]
                                                 AND s.[Last Modified When] > c.[Valid From]
                                                 AND s.[Last Modified When] <= c.[Valid To]
									             ORDER BY c.[Valid From]), 0),
            s.[Stock Item Key] = COALESCE((SELECT TOP(1) si.[Stock Item Key]
                                           FROM Dimension.[Stock Item] AS si
                                           WHERE si.[WWI Stock Item ID] = s.[WWI Stock Item ID]
                                           AND s.[Last Modified When] > si.[Valid From]
                                           AND s.[Last Modified When] <= si.[Valid To]
									       ORDER BY si.[Valid From]), 0),
            s.[Salesperson Key] = COALESCE((SELECT TOP(1) e.[Employee Key]
                                            FROM Dimension.Employee AS e
                                            WHERE e.[WWI Employee ID] = s.[WWI Salesperson ID]
                                            AND s.[Last Modified When] > e.[Valid From]
                                            AND s.[Last Modified When] <= e.[Valid To]
									        ORDER BY e.[Valid From]), 0)
    FROM Integration.Sale_Staging AS s;

    -- Remove any existing entries for any of these invoices

    DELETE s
    FROM Fact.Sale AS s
    WHERE s.[WWI Invoice ID] IN (SELECT [WWI Invoice ID] FROM Integration.Sale_Staging);

    -- Insert all current details for these invoices

    INSERT Fact.Sale
        ([City Key], [Customer Key], [Bill To Customer Key], [Stock Item Key], [Invoice Date Key], [Delivery Date Key],
         [Salesperson Key], [WWI Invoice ID], [Description], Package, Quantity, [Unit Price], [Tax Rate],
         [Total Excluding Tax], [Tax Amount], Profit, [Total Including Tax], [Total Dry Items], [Total Chiller Items], [Lineage Key])
    SELECT [City Key], [Customer Key], [Bill To Customer Key], [Stock Item Key], [Invoice Date Key], [Delivery Date Key],
           [Salesperson Key], [WWI Invoice ID], [Description], Package, Quantity, [Unit Price], [Tax Rate],
           [Total Excluding Tax], [Tax Amount], Profit, [Total Including Tax], [Total Dry Items], [Total Chiller Items], @LineageKey
    FROM Integration.Sale_Staging;

    UPDATE Integration.Lineage
        SET [Data Load Completed] = SYSDATETIME(),
            [Was Successful] = 1
    WHERE [Lineage Key] = @LineageKey;

    UPDATE Integration.[ETL Cutoff]
        SET [Cutoff Time] = (SELECT [Source System Cutoff Time]
                             FROM Integration.Lineage
                             WHERE [Lineage Key] = @LineageKey)
    FROM Integration.[ETL Cutoff]
    WHERE [Table Name] = N'Sale';

    COMMIT;

    RETURN 0;
END;

from pyspark.sql import functions as F


def run(spark, tables):
    for name, df in tables.items():
        df.createOrReplaceTempView(name.replace(".", "_").replace(" ", "_"))

    # Find the dimension keys required
    spark.sql("""
        UPDATE s
            SET s.`City Key` = COALESCE((SELECT c.`City Key`
                                         FROM Dimension_City AS c
                                         WHERE c.`WWI City ID` = s.`WWI City ID`
                                         AND s.`Last Modified When` > c.`Valid From`
                                         AND s.`Last Modified When` <= c.`Valid To`
                                         ORDER BY c.`Valid From` LIMIT 1), 0)
        FROM Integration_Sale_Staging AS s
    """)

    staging = spark.table("Integration_Sale_Staging")
    fact = tables["Fact.Sale"]
    kept = fact.join(staging.select("WWI Invoice ID").distinct(), "WWI Invoice ID", "left_anti")
    return {
        "Integration.Sale_Staging": staging,
        "Fact.Sale": kept.unionByName(staging.select(*fact.columns)),
    }

from pyspark.sql import Window


def run(spark, tables):
    lineage = tables["Integration.Lineage"]
    etl_cutoff = tables["Integration.ETL Cutoff"]
    city = tables["Dimension.City"]
    customer = tables["Dimension.Customer"]
    employee = tables["Dimension.Employee"]
    stock_item = tables["Dimension.Stock Item"]
    fact_sale = tables["Fact.Sale"]
    staging = tables["Integration.Sale_Staging"]

    staging_cols = staging.columns
    fact_cols = fact_sale.columns
    lineage_cols = lineage.columns
    cutoff_cols = etl_cutoff.columns

    # DECLARE @LineageKey = TOP(1) ... ORDER BY [Lineage Key] DESC
    lk_row = (
        lineage
        .filter((F.col("Table Name") == F.lit("Sale")) & F.col("Data Load Completed").isNull())
        .orderBy(F.col("Lineage Key").desc_nulls_last())
        .select("Lineage Key")
        .limit(1)
        .collect()
    )
    lineage_key = lk_row[0]["Lineage Key"] if lk_row else None

    # UPDATE staging: dimension key lookups
    s = staging.withColumn("__rid", F.monotonically_increasing_id())

    def lookup(df, dim, dim_id_col, dim_key_col, stg_id_col, target_col):
        d = dim.select(
            F.col(dim_id_col).alias("__d_id"),
            F.col(dim_key_col).alias("__d_key"),
            F.col("Valid From").alias("__d_from"),
            F.col("Valid To").alias("__d_to"),
        )
        cond = (
            (F.col("__d_id") == F.col(stg_id_col))
            & (F.col("Last Modified When") > F.col("__d_from"))
            & (F.col("Last Modified When") <= F.col("__d_to"))
        )
        joined = df.join(d, cond, "left")
        w = Window.partitionBy("__rid").orderBy(
            F.col("__d_from").asc_nulls_first(), F.col("__d_key").asc_nulls_first()
        )
        joined = (
            joined.withColumn("__rn", F.row_number().over(w))
            .filter(F.col("__rn") == 1)
            .withColumn(
                target_col,
                F.coalesce(F.col("__d_key").cast("long"), F.lit(0).cast("long")),
            )
            .drop("__d_id", "__d_key", "__d_from", "__d_to", "__rn")
        )
        return joined

    # Dimension.City is large, so only look at current city versions
    current_city = city.filter(F.col("Valid To") == F.lit("9999-12-31 23:59:59.9999999").cast("timestamp"))
    s = lookup(s, current_city, "WWI City ID", "City Key", "WWI City ID", "City Key")
    s = lookup(s, customer, "WWI Customer ID", "Customer Key", "WWI Customer ID", "Customer Key")
    s = lookup(s, customer, "WWI Customer ID", "Customer Key", "WWI Bill To Customer ID", "Bill To Customer Key")
    s = lookup(s, stock_item, "WWI Stock Item ID", "Stock Item Key", "WWI Stock Item ID", "Stock Item Key")
    s = lookup(s, employee, "WWI Employee ID", "Employee Key", "WWI Salesperson ID", "Salesperson Key")

    s = s.localCheckpoint()

    new_staging = s.select(*[F.col(c) for c in staging_cols])

    # DELETE from Fact.Sale where invoice in staging
    stg_ids = (
        staging.select(F.col("WWI Invoice ID").alias("__inv"))
        .filter(F.col("__inv").isNotNull())
        .distinct()
    )
    kept = fact_sale.join(
        stg_ids, fact_sale["WWI Invoice ID"] == stg_ids["__inv"], "left_anti"
    )

    # INSERT new rows with identity Sale Key
    max_row = fact_sale.agg(F.max(F.col("Sale Key")).alias("m")).collect()
    max_key = max_row[0]["m"] if max_row and max_row[0]["m"] is not None else 0

    w_ins = Window.orderBy(F.col("Sale Staging Key").asc_nulls_first(), F.col("__rid"))
    ins = s.withColumn("__rn", F.row_number().over(w_ins))

    fact_types = dict((f.name, f.dataType) for f in fact_sale.schema.fields)

    def fc(name, expr):
        return expr.cast(fact_types[name]).alias(name)

    insert_exprs = []
    for c in fact_cols:
        if c == "Sale Key":
            insert_exprs.append(fc(c, F.lit(max_key) + F.col("__rn")))
        elif c == "Lineage Key":
            insert_exprs.append(fc(c, F.lit(lineage_key)))
        else:
            insert_exprs.append(fc(c, F.col(c)))
    inserted = ins.select(*insert_exprs)

    new_fact = kept.select(*[F.col(c) for c in fact_cols]).unionByName(inserted)

    # UPDATE Integration.Lineage
    lin_types = dict((f.name, f.dataType) for f in lineage.schema.fields)
    if lineage_key is not None:
        is_target = F.col("Lineage Key") == F.lit(lineage_key)
    else:
        is_target = F.lit(False)
    is_target = F.coalesce(is_target, F.lit(False))

    lin_exprs = []
    for c in lineage_cols:
        if c == "Data Load Completed":
            lin_exprs.append(
                F.when(is_target, F.current_timestamp().cast(lin_types[c]))
                .otherwise(F.col(c))
                .alias(c)
            )
        elif c == "Was Successful":
            lin_exprs.append(

                .otherwise(F.col(c))
                .alias(c)
            )
        else:
            lin_exprs.append(F.col(c))
    new_lineage = lineage.select(*lin_exprs)

    # UPDATE Integration.ETL Cutoff
    cutoff_val = None
    if lineage_key is not None:
        rows = (
            lineage.filter(F.col("Lineage Key") == F.lit(lineage_key))
            .select("Source System Cutoff Time")
            .limit(1)
            .collect()
        )
        cutoff_val = rows[0]["Source System Cutoff Time"] if rows else None

    cut_types = dict((f.name, f.dataType) for f in etl_cutoff.schema.fields)
    is_sale = F.coalesce(F.col("Table Name") == F.lit("Sale"), F.lit(False))

            cut_exprs.append(

                .otherwise(F.col(c))
                .alias(c)
            )
        else:
            cut_exprs.append(F.col(c))
    new_cutoff = etl_cutoff.select(*cut_exprs)

    return {
        "Integration.Sale_Staging": new_staging,
        "Fact.Sale": new_fact,
        "Integration.Lineage": new_lineage,

CREATE PROCEDURE Integration.MigrateStagedCityData
WITH EXECUTE AS OWNER
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    SET XACT_ABORT ON;

    DECLARE @EndOfTime datetime2(7) =  '99991231 23:59:59.9999999';

    BEGIN TRAN;

    DECLARE @LineageKey int = (SELECT TOP(1) [Lineage Key]
                               FROM Integration.Lineage
                               WHERE [Table Name] = N'City'
                               AND [Data Load Completed] IS NULL
                               ORDER BY [Lineage Key] DESC);

    WITH RowsToCloseOff
    AS
    (
        SELECT c.[WWI City ID], MIN(c.[Valid From]) AS [Valid From]
        FROM Integration.City_Staging AS c
        GROUP BY c.[WWI City ID]
    )
    UPDATE c
        SET c.[Valid To] = rtco.[Valid From]
    FROM Dimension.City AS c
    INNER JOIN RowsToCloseOff AS rtco
    ON c.[WWI City ID] = rtco.[WWI City ID]
    WHERE c.[Valid To] = @EndOfTime;

    INSERT Dimension.City
        ([WWI City ID], City, [State Province], Country, Continent,
         [Sales Territory], Region, Subregion, [Location],
         [Latest Recorded Population], [Valid From], [Valid To],
         [Lineage Key])
    SELECT [WWI City ID], City, [State Province], Country, Continent,
           [Sales Territory], Region, Subregion, [Location],
           [Latest Recorded Population], [Valid From], [Valid To],
           @LineageKey
    FROM Integration.City_Staging;

    UPDATE Integration.Lineage
        SET [Data Load Completed] = SYSDATETIME(),
            [Was Successful] = 1
    WHERE [Lineage Key] = @LineageKey;

    UPDATE Integration.[ETL Cutoff]
        SET [Cutoff Time] = (SELECT [Source System Cutoff Time]
                             FROM Integration.Lineage
                             WHERE [Lineage Key] = @LineageKey)
    FROM Integration.[ETL Cutoff]
    WHERE [Table Name] = N'City';

    COMMIT;

    RETURN 0;
END;

from pyspark.sql import Window


def run(spark, tables):
    lineage = tables["Integration.Lineage"]
    cutoff = tables["Integration.ETL Cutoff"]
    city = tables["Dimension.City"]
    staging = tables["Integration.City_Staging"]

    lk = (lineage
          .filter((F.col("Table Name") == "City") & F.col("Data Load Completed").isNull())
          .orderBy(F.col("Lineage Key").desc())
          .select("Lineage Key").limit(1).collect())
    lineage_key = lk[0]["Lineage Key"] if lk else None

    # Close off the cities that have new versions in staging

BEGIN

                               WHERE [Table Name] = N'Movement'
                               AND [Data Load Completed] IS NULL
                               ORDER BY [Lineage Key] DESC);

    UPDATE m
        SET m.[Stock Item Key] = COALESCE((SELECT TOP(1) si.[Stock Item Key]
                                           FROM Dimension.[Stock Item] AS si
                                           WHERE si.[WWI Stock Item ID] = m.[WWI Stock Item ID]
                                           AND m.[Last Modifed When] > si.[Valid From]
                                           AND m.[Last Modifed When] <= si.[Valid To]
									       ORDER BY si.[Valid From]), 0),
            m.[Customer Key] = COALESCE((SELECT TOP(1) c.[Customer Key]
                                         FROM Dimension.Customer AS c
                                         WHERE c.[WWI Customer ID] = m.[WWI Customer ID]
                                         AND m.[Last Modifed When] > c.[Valid From]
                                         AND m.[Last Modifed When] <= c.[Valid To]
									     ORDER BY c.[Valid From]), 0),
            m.[Supplier Key] = COALESCE((SELECT TOP(1) s.[Supplier Key]
                                         FROM Dimension.Supplier AS s
                                         WHERE s.[WWI Supplier ID] = m.[WWI Supplier ID]
                                         AND m.[Last Modifed When] > s.[Valid From]
                                         AND m.[Last Modifed When] <= s.[Valid To]
									     ORDER BY s.[Valid From]), 0),
            m.[Transaction Type Key] = COALESCE((SELECT TOP(1) tt.[Transaction Type Key]
                                                 FROM Dimension.[Transaction Type] AS tt
                                                 WHERE tt.[WWI Transaction Type ID] = m.[WWI Transaction Type ID]
                                                 AND m.[Last Modifed When] > tt.[Valid From]
                                                 AND m.[Last Modifed When] <= tt.[Valid To]
									             ORDER BY tt.[Valid From]), 0)
    FROM Integration.Movement_Staging AS m;

    -- Merge the data into the fact table

    MERGE Fact.Movement AS m
    USING Integration.Movement_Staging AS ms
    ON m.[WWI Stock Item Transaction ID] = ms.[WWI Stock Item Transaction ID]
    WHEN MATCHED THEN
        UPDATE SET m.[Date Key] = ms.[Date Key],
                   m.[Stock Item Key] = ms.[Stock Item Key],
                   m.[Customer Key] = ms.[Customer Key],
                   m.[Supplier Key] = ms.[Supplier Key],
                   m.[Transaction Type Key] = ms.[Transaction Type Key],
                   m.[WWI Invoice ID] = ms.[WWI Invoice ID],
                   m.[WWI Purchase Order ID] = ms.[WWI Purchase Order ID],
                   m.Quantity = ms.Quantity,
                   m.[Lineage Key] = @LineageKey
    WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN
        INSERT ([Date Key], [Stock Item Key], [Customer Key], [Supplier Key], [Transaction Type Key],
                [WWI Stock Item Transaction ID], [WWI Invoice ID], [WWI Purchase Order ID], Quantity, [Lineage Key])
        VALUES (ms.[Date Key], ms.[Stock Item Key], ms.[Customer Key], ms.[Supplier Key], ms.[Transaction Type Key],
                ms.[WWI Stock Item Transaction ID], ms.[WWI Invoice ID], ms.[WWI Purchase Order ID], ms.Quantity, @LineageKey);

    UPDATE Integration.Lineage
        SET [Data Load Completed] = SYSDATETIME(),
            [Was Successful] = 1
    WHERE [Lineage Key] = @LineageKey;

    UPDATE Integration.[ETL Cutoff]

                             FROM Integration.Lineage
                             WHERE [Lineage Key] = @LineageKey)
    FROM Integration.[ETL Cutoff]
    WHERE [Table Name] = N'Movement';

    COMMIT;

    RETURN 0;
END;
